text.p: Zaire's veteran president, Mobutu Sese Seko, returned home on Friday after medical tests in Europe, state radio reported.
The radio said that Mobutu, who visited Morocco on his way home, had gone direct to his jungle palace at Gbadolite.
Mobutu, who went back to Europe for tests following prostate surgery there in August, returns to Zaire following an escalation in fighting between troops and rebels in the east.
The rebels, who launched their revolt in October and demand that he stand down, attacked on several fronts in response to an army counter-offensive launched on January 20.
Both sides report capturing towns in a war zone where battles are being fought on several fronts.
Zaire's government has alleged Rwandan and Ugandan troops have enetered the country to boost the rebel thrusts, a both nations deny.
